answer: An identity earns its seat through SIM applet signature with IMSI-derived key, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 13 minutes once; the operator of 754 fakes spends 9802 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. The voyage sits in the mechanism itself, the vertex sits in the price of faking it, and the haven sits in the record no template can forge. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
